PluginEntity.Name: docker.filter
PluginEntity.Overview:
Adds a filter box to the top of the Docker tab so you can find a container by typing part of its name instead of scrolling a long list.
Fully compatible with folder.view2. When containers are grouped into collapsed folders they are moved out of the container table entirely, so an ordinary filter cannot see them. docker.filter reads both the table and folder.view2's internal storage, and lifts matching containers into a results group with all their normal controls intact. Typing a folder's name matches everything inside it.
Clearing the box restores the table exactly as it was. The plugin stores no configuration and the filter always starts empty.
